paite: Huan zawlnei Elisha in zawlneite tapate lak a khat asam a, akiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, hiai sathau bawm tawi inla, Ramoth-gilead ah va hoh in.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ding In Jehu Thaunilh Ahi
english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Na va tun chiang in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu va zongkhia inla; va lut inla, a-unaute lak a pan samkhia inla, dantan sunggil ah lutpih in.
english: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

paite: Huchi in sathau bawm la inla, alu ah sung inla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi," chi in. "Huchi in kong hong inla, taikhia in, om sawt ke'n,” achi hi.
english: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

paite: Huchi in tangval, zawlnei tangvalpa Ramoth-gilead ah ahohta hi.
english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Ava tunleh ngai in, sepaih heutute atukhawm ua; ama'n, "Sepaih heutu, na kiang a gen ding thukhah ka nei," achi hi. Jehu in, "Kua pen kiang ah eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Nang kiang ah, sepaih heutupa," achi hi,
english: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

paite: Athou a, inn ah alut a; alu ah sathau asung a, akiang ah, "ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA mipite, Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh hi.
english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Yahweh, even over Israel.

paite: Ka sikha zawlneite sisan leh TOUPA sikha tengteng sisan phu Jezebel tung a ka laktheihna ding in na pu Ahab inkote na that ding hi.
english: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Yahweh, at the hand of Jezebel.

paite: Ahab inko tengteng amangthang vek ding uh. Ahab a pan pasal taphot Israel gam a zalen hi in sikha hitaleh ka hihmang ding hi.
english: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

paite: Ahab inkote Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

paite: Uite'n Jezreel khokulh zul ah Jezebel ane ding ua, amah vui ding mi a-om kei ding, chi in," achi hi. Huchi in kong ahong a, ataikheta hi.
english: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

paite: Huchi in Jehu bel atoupa sikhate kiang ah ahong pawt a; khat in akiang ah, "Hoih lam thu hia? Huai mihaipa koi a pan na kiang a hong ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Huai mi na thei ua; athugen leng na thei uh," achi hi.
english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

paite: Amau, "Thei maizen dia, tu'n hon hilh in," achi uh. Ama'n, "Hichibang in ahon chi ahi: 'TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi, " achi hi.
english: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘Yahweh says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

paite: Huchi in michih in apuan uh asuah somsom ua, kailawn tung ah aphahsak chiat ua, "Jehu kumpipa ahita," chi in pengkul amutta uhi.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”

paite: Huchi in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu in Joram thahna ding aguksawm hi. Siria kumpipa Hazael ziak in Joram leh Israelte tengteng in Ramoth-gilead khua aveng uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Joram Thah Ahi
english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael toh kumpipa Joram akidouna ua Siria mite'n asukliam uh, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawn hi. Huchi in Jehu in, "Kei lam a pang na hih uleh kuamah Jezreel a hiai thu gen ding in khua a pan paikhesak kei un," achi hi.
english: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

paite: Huchi in Jehu bel kangtalai ah atuang a, Jezreel ah ahoh a, huai ah Joram alum hi. Judah kumpipa Ahaziah leng Joram veh ding in ahohsuk hi.
english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

paite: Jezreel kulh ah galvilmi adingh a, Jehu pawlte amah toh hong pai amu a, “Mi tampi ka mu,” achi hi. Joram in, "Sakol tungtuangmi amau va dawn ding in sawl inla, hoih lam thu hia? va chi uhen,” achi hi.
english: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

paite: Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang amau dawn ding in akuan a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, “Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?” achi hi. Jehu in, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in," achi hi. Galvilmi'n, "I mi sawl akiang uh ava tung a, himahleh ahong kik nawn het kei mawk a," chi in ahilh hi.
english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

paite: Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang asawl nawn a, huai mi leng akiang uh ava tung a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" achi hi. Jehu in adawng a, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in,” achi hi.
english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

paite: Galvilmi leng akiang uh ava tung a, amah leng ahong kik nawn het kei mawk hi. "Huai kangtalai kihawldan leng Nimshi tapa Jehu hawldan geih ahi; mihai bang mai in ahawl hi," achi hi.
english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

paite: Joram in, "Kimansak un," achi a; kangtalai akimansakta uh. Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joram leh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah amau kangtalai tuaktuak in ava pawtkhia ua, Jehu tuak ding in ataikhia ua, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah ava mu uhi.
english: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

paite: Joram in Jehu amuh in hichi ahong hi a, "Lemna toh hong pai na hia, Jehu?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Na nu Jezebel angkawmna leh bumna atam lai teng bangchi in lemna a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
english: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

paite: Joram akihei a, atai a, Ahaziah kiang ah, "Kikhem a kilehbawlna om ei ve, Ahaziah," achi hi.
english: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

paite: Jehu in athalpeu atheihtawp in alai a, Joram liang leh liang kikal ah akap a, thaltang in alungtang apailet a, akangtalai sung ah apuklut hi.
english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

paite: Huchi in Jehu in asepaih heutu Bidkar kiang ah, "Dom inla, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah paikhia in. Tuma lam a nang toh apa Ahab nung a i tuankhawm lai a TOUPA'N hiai puakgik atung ah anga hi.
english: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Yahweh laid this burden on him:

paite: TOUPA'N zan in Naboth sisan leh atapate sisan ka muh ngei ahi," achi hi. "TOUPA'N, hiai mun ngei ah ka hon thuk ding," achi nawn hi. Huchi in "TOUPA thu bang in dom inla, hiai mun ngei ah paikhia in," achi hi.
english: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says Yahweh. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Himahleh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah in huai amuh in huan in lampi ah atai hi. Jehu in adelh a, "Amah leng huai kangtalai sung ah that un," achi hi. Huchi in Ibleam kiang, Gur zottouhna ah asatliam uhi. Meggiddo ah atailut a, huai ah asita hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah Thah Ahi
english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

paite: Amite'n Jerusalem ah kangtalai in apaipih ua, amah han ah, api-le- pute lak ah David khopi ah avui uhi.
english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

paite: Ahab tapa Joram kum sawm- le-khat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Ahaziah alal pan hi.
english: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jezreel ah Jehu ava lut chih Jezebel in ana za hi. Huchi in amitte anuh a, asam azem a, tohlet ah ana dakkhia hi.
heading: Kumpinu Jezebel Thah Ahi
english: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

paite: Jehu kulh kongpi a, ahong lut laitak in, "Na pu thatpa nang Zimri, lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" ana chi hi.
english: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

paite: Tohlet lam nga in amah adaktou a, "Kei lam a pang kuakua na om ua? Kua?" achi hi. Michilgeh nih hiam, thum hiam amah lam nga in ahong dakkhia uhi.
english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

paite: Ama'n, "Hon lawnkhia un," achi hi. Huchi in alawnkhia ua; asi khenkhat in baang leh sakolte atheh nengnung a; ama'n lei ah akhe in ana chil hi.
english: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

paite: Huchi in alut a, ne in adawn a, "Hamse thuaknu va dom unla, va vui un, kumpipa tanu lah ahi ngal a." achi hi.
english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

paite: Vui ding in akuan ua; himahleh aluguh, akhebomte leh akhutpek bomte kia lou ngal amu kei uh.
english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

paite: Huchi in ahong pai nawn in ahong hilh uh. Ama'n, "Hiai TOUPA'N asikha Tishbi mi Elijah zang a, Jezreel kulhchin ah uite'n Jezebel ane ding ua;
english: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

paite: Jezebel luang Jezreel khokulh chin a huan a ekchim bang ahi dia, huchi a, hiai Jezebel ei ve, achihlouhna ding un, chi a agen ahi," achi hi.
english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”
